title: OmniDexVLG: Learning Dexterous Grasp Generation from Vision Language Model-Guided Grasp Semantics, Taxonomy and Functional Affordance
authors: Lei Zhang, Diwen Zheng, Kaixin Bai, Zhenshan Bing, Zoltán-Csaba Márton, Zhaopeng Chen, Alois Christian Knoll, Jianwei Zhang

tldr.zh: OmniDexVLG 用多 Agent 协作理解手物接触、推断抓型并生成语言标注，再训练点云—语言条件扩散模型，实现对抓取部位、参与手指和抓型的精细控制。
tldr.en: OmniDexVLG uses collaborating Agents to interpret hand–object contacts, infer grasp types and generate language annotations, then trains point-cloud/language-conditioned diffusion to control grasp regions, participating fingers and grasp types.

evaluation_scope.zh: DataGen 按抓型、指节接触区域及物体功能部位采样，优化并经物理仿真筛选抓姿；Reasoner 结合多视图、手配置与接触信息，通过多 Agent、知识检索及分步推理生成语义标注；GraspNet 以局部点云和指令为条件生成目标抓姿。三模块不等于三个 Agent，Agent 贡献集中于语义理解与数据标注，未展示在线 Agent 反馈重规划；动作生成不使用 RL。真机由 PyRoki 规划轨迹、阻抗控制执行。数据生成和语义理解涉及 LEAP 与 DLR-HIT II，最终网络仅用 LEAP 做仿真与 Diana 机械臂真机验证；不代表统一跨手模型。输出抓姿而非连续操作轨迹。项目页可访问，代码、数据及预训练权重下载尚未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: DataGen samples and physically validates taxonomy/contact/affordance-aware grasps. Reasoner combines multiview images, hand configurations and contacts with multi-Agent reasoning, retrieval and stepwise inference to annotate data. GraspNet generates target poses from partial point clouds and instructions. The three modules are not three Agents: Agent contributions concern semantic understanding/annotation, without demonstrated online Agent replanning or RL action learning. PyRoki plans hardware trajectories for impedance control. Data generation/reasoning involve LEAP and DLR-HIT II; the final generator is evaluated only with LEAP in simulation and on a Diana arm, not as a unified cross-hand model. Outputs are poses, not continuous manipulation trajectories. Project access is verified; code, data and pretrained downloads are not.
